# QECTOR Decoder 3

> Python and Rust quantum error correction decoder package for QEC research, decoder validation, reproducible artifacts, and commercial evaluation.

QECTOR Decoder 3 is distributed on PyPI as qector-decoder-v3. Public Python API includes 20+ decoder families and helpers: UnionFindDecoder, FastUnionFindDecoder, BlossomDecoder, SparseBlossomDecoder, BeliefMatching, BpOsdDecoder, BatchDecoder / CPUBatchDecoder, CUDABatchDecoder, OpenCLBatchDecoder, AutoDecoder, HybridDecoder, PredecodedDecoder, LookupTableDecoder, SlidingWindowDecoder, StreamingDecoder, GNNBeliefMatcher, GNNPredecoder, NeuralPredecoder, DecoderPool, LERBenchmark, plus code generators and Stim/Sinter compatibility. Status ranges from stable (UF, Blossom, batch, AutoDecoder) to experimental/research (GNN, Neural, streaming).

## Recommended install command

pip install qector-decoder-v3

## Boundaries

- Commercial use requires written licensing.
- Benchmark claims are tied to published artifacts and must be reproduced on target hardware; PyMatching remains the reference for standard MWPM latency on surface-code workloads.
- The decoder package is source-available, not open-source.
